Thread-pool offload helpers for blocking/CPU-heavy tasks. Uses malebolgia instead of the deprecated std/threadpool module.Records the server whose event loop runs queued offload completions.Runs expr on the offload pool and returns an OffloadOutcome using DefaultOffloadTimeoutMs.Returns the short string class name for an OffloadOutcome kind.Renders an OffloadOutcome as a compact JSON event string with class, operation, and correlation fields.

macro runOffload(expr: typed): untyped

Run a blocking call on malebolgia's worker pool and return a Future. Example: let rows = await runOffload(loadRowsBlocking())

Note: this expects a call expression, e.g. foo(a, b).
